Agent Name: Orchestrator  
Step Number: 12  
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator failed to identify that the lowest price of $445,000 was from a property sold in December 2024, not January 2023. This error occurred when the Orchestrator incorrectly updated the ledger and prematurely concluded that relevant data had not been found, despite the WebSurfer providing clear data with dates in step 11. The Orchestrator did not validate the date range of the sales data and instead continued to loop through redundant searches and actions without addressing the core issue. This oversight led to the incorrect solution being provided.
